notes: Site: SAP Commerce Cloud (Spartacus/Angular) storefront, nitori-net.jp/ec/. Discovery: main nav is a client-rendered SPA shell (raw SSR HTML has almost no body content); direct URL guess https://www.nitori-net.jp/ec/ranking/ returned a 301 redirect to https://www.nitori-net.jp/ec/brands/nitori/ranking/, confirmed via sitemap.xml -> sitemap_content_1.xml -> https://www.nitori-net.jp/ec/ranking/ and a dedicated sitemap_ranking_1.xml (798 leaf URLs). Rendered the hub page (Claude-in-Chrome, tier 3 -- tier 2 Playwright/CDP was unavailable in this environment, no local install; tier-1 HTTP SSR HTML for /ranking/ and every leaf ranking page contains no product data at all, only CMS component metadata, because the content is populated client-side by a third-party recommendation engine, 'Rtoaster' -- confirmed via component names 'Rtoaster Ranking Component' / 'RtoasterMainRanking Component' / 'RtoasterCategory Component' embedded in the page's CMS slot list). Page heading/breadcrumb: 'カテゴリ別人気ランキング' (Popularity Ranking by Category), i.e. the site frames Bestsellers/ranking purely as a per-department concept, not one flat sitewide listing. The hub lists ~37 top-level departments (Bed, Mattress, Bedding, Sofa, Appliances, Lighting, Curtains, Carpet/Rug/Mat, Cushion/Cover, Table, Chair, Kitchen Cabinet, TV Stand/Living Storage/Buddhist Altar, Storage Furniture, Storage Cases, Bookshelf/Rack/Shelf, Desk/Office Chair, Study Desk/School Bag/Kids Items, Kotatsu, Kitchen Goods, Kitchen Storage, Tableware/Cutlery, Interior Goods, Daily Necessities, Bath/Washroom, Toilet, Laundry, Cleaning, Baby Goods, Gardening, Plants, Outdoor/Leisure, Office Furniture/Business, Pet Supplies, Fashion/Roomwear, Health/Beauty Devices, Nursing Care) plus a 'さらに見る' (see more) control for additional departments, and this same per-department ranking structure additionally repeats across 3 more brand storefronts under the same domain (business/decohome/nplus per sitemap_ranking_1.xml), which is how the sitemap total reaches 798 leaf URLs. Opened one leaf example directly ('布団・寝具ランキング' / Bedding Ranking, https://www.nitori-net.jp/ec/brands/nitori/cat/Shingu/ranking/) to validate: it genuinely lists real, browsable products (confirms brief criterion 1/2 -- this is not editorial/marketing) as a fixed, numbered Top-1-through-20 list with crown/rank badges; there is no pagination control, 'load more', or any site-declared total-count text anywhere on the page -- the number '20' is only knowable by counting the rendered ranked items, not a number the site itself states. The parenthesized numbers next to prices on both the hub and leaf pages (e.g. '(405)', '(171)') are star-rating REVIEW counts, not product/listing counts -- verified against the star-icon UI directly beside them. Given ~798 such department-scoped, non-countable Top-20 widgets exist and none carries a site-declared qty, exhaustively enumerating every leaf as its own row would (a) fabricate a uniform qty value site-wide with no real evidentiary basis beyond manual counting per page, and (b) essentially reproduce the company's entire category tree rather than a bounded merchandising-PLP list. Recorded the hub as the primary Bestsellers row (qty null, flagged) plus one verified leaf as a concrete, honestly-sourced example of the genuine substructure; the remaining ~797 department/brand leaves were not individually fetched/enumerated -- see flag for exact reasoning. Local-language terms considered: 人気商品/ランキング (matched, this is the site's actual term -- 'カテゴリ別人気ランキング'), ベストセラー and 売れ筋 (not found in site nav/copy).

rows.evidence: Rendered page heading 'カテゴリ別人気ランキング' (Popularity Ranking by Category); lists ~37 department links (each '<Department>ランキング'), plus 'さらに見る' to reveal more; CMS component list includes 'Rtoaster Ranking Component' / 'RtoasterMainRanking Component' confirming a recommendation-engine-driven ranking widget rather than a static catalog page
rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: no site-declared total exists for Bestsellers as a whole or for any individual department ranking -- each department page is a fixed Top-20 recommendation-engine (Rtoaster) widget with no pagination/total text, and the genuine children (confirmed via sitemap_ranking_1.xml) number ~798 leaf URLs across 4 brand storefronts (nitori/business/decohome/nplus), too many and too structurally uniform (all non-countable) to enumerate individually in this pass. See notes for full reasoning.
